title: Basketball games in progress stay on Games
items: A basketball game left Games at tipoff but only reached Results once it was final, so a game being played, such as Michigan State vs Detroit Mercy, showed nowhere. Games now keeps it under In play until the final score arrives. Football games already under way move to In play too.
Games with no announced time stay on Games for their whole date. Six of Saturday's basketball games had been moved to Results at dawn as if they were already over.
Every game in play or due today is on the first page of Games. Only later days wait behind Load more, so a busy Saturday no longer hides part of the day's games.
Results lists every game waiting for a final score, not just the first 12.
